title: FHFA House Price Index — Monthly Index (August 2026 data)
source: EST: fhfa.gov/data/hpi fetched direct 2026-09-06 (HTTP 200, 89,663 bytes), the agency's own "FHFA HPI Release Dates" table, whose "2026 HPI Release Dates" block reads "Tuesday, October 27 | Monthly Index | August 2026". The same table carries the surrounding 2026 rows (September 29, November 24, December 29) and the full 2027 schedule, so this is a forward calendar the publisher maintains rather than a one-off announcement. No release time is stated on the primary and none is claimed here. Filed estimate per the lane's no-self-confirm limit on an event discovered in-sweep. Checked 2026-09-06
notes: DISCOVERED during the new-home-sales-2026-10-27 initial-research adjacency sweep (2026-09-06). It is the repeat-sales house-PRICE read landing on the SAME DAY as the proposer, which tracks the QUANTITY of new-home demand — the calendar follows housing quantity in six places (existing-home-sales, pending-home-sales, housing-starts, construction-spending, and now the two new-home-sales editions) and has no house-price entry at all. The proposer's own release publishes a median and an average new-home sales price every month (July 2026: median $393,800, -0.9% y/y; average $508,800, +5.4% y/y) with no independent read beside it, and the gap between those two lines is the composition story the proposer's `This quarter` call rests on. The sibling new-home-sales-2026-11-25 lane proposed fhfa-hpi-2026-11-24, the QUARTERLY edition one month later; this is the monthly edition and a different date, so the two proposals stack rather than collide. Impact LOW, symbols empty: no house playbook is macro-keyed (0 hits, re-grepped 2026-09-06), FHFA HPI appears on neither the trigger nor the other-releases column of the Atlanta Fed's GDPNowcastDataReleaseDates.xlsx, and the proposer's own tape work measured a well-powered null across eight housing-adjacent instruments on its release days. S&P CoreLogic Case-Shiller shares this last-Tuesday slot historically but its publisher returned HTTP 403 to this runner on 2026-09-06 (recorded in the proposer's probe-ref.blocked), so it is NOT proposed — no primary, no entry. Proposed as an estimate; nothing here licenses an entry.
